description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of License Issued to Kanrich Finance Ltd. due to amalgamation with Nation Lanka Finance PLC. under the Finance Business Act, No 42 of 2011
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance company's licence due to amalgamation with another financial institution under the Finance Business Act. This content deals specifically with commercial/business regulatory matters - specifically the licensing and consolidation of financial institutions - which falls under the Commercial classification (Type 6). While it mentions the Central Bank Governor, it does so only in his official capacity as the issuing authority, not as a government personnel change or structural reorganization. The core content is commercial regulatory action.
